name: Meterwise – Price by Size for WooCommerce
author: timezholding

sections.description:
Meterwise lets your customers type in the size they need, and charges by the square metre (or square foot) or by the metre (or foot). Think curtains, flooring, glass, fabric, banners, wallpaper, cut-to-size boards and cables.

What you get

  • Price per m², m, ft², ft, yd², yd, metre or foot of edge (perimeter), or per m³ or ft³ (width × height × a fixed thickness). The normal product price is the price per unit.
  • Customers can enter mm, cm, m, inches, feet or yards. You choose per product, and new products start with your shop’s own unit (WooCommerce > Settings > Products).
  • Fractions work too: customers can type 36 1/2 or 36½ inches.
  • Works with any currency and any price format you set in WooCommerce.
  • Translation-ready. Translations are managed on translate.wordpress.org.
  • Minimum, maximum and step for each dimension.
  • A minimum billable amount.
  • Works with page builders: the fields are printed with the standard add-to-cart form, or with the [meterwise_fields] shortcode.
  • Easy to style: set CSS variables such as –meterwise-error and –meterwise-input-width.
  • Decimal comma or point. “1,5” and “1.5” both work.
  • Live price on the product page, shown in a clear price block next to the add to cart button.
  • Works with simple and variable products. Each variation can have its own price per unit.
  • Size and area are shown in the cart, checkout, order, order emails and when a customer orders again.
  • Works with the classic and block cart and checkout, and with High-Performance Order Storage.

Meterwise Pro

Meterwise Pro is for shops that sell made-to-measure products every day. It adds:

  • Price tables, matrix: a fixed price for each width and height band, pasted straight from Excel. A size rounds up to the next band.
  • Price tables, tiers: a lower price per unit when the customer orders a larger amount.
  • Extra for waste (for example +10% fabric for cutting and pattern match), added to the billed area, with the measured and the billed area shown to the customer.
  • A minimum price per item and a fixed fee per item, for cutting or handling costs.
  • Weight per unit, so the cart weight follows the billed area and shipping rates stay correct.
  • Sell in whole packs, boxes or rolls: the size is rounded up to full packs and the customer sees the number of packs.
  • Stock counted in m², m, ft² or ft: each order takes the billed size out of stock, and customers cannot order more than is available.
  • Wallpaper by the roll: the customer enters a wall size and Meterwise works out strips, pattern repeat and rolls.
  • A “Request a quote” button: you get the sizes and the calculated price by email.
  • CSV import: set up size pricing for many products at once, found by SKU.
  • Metric and imperial side by side (for example 2 m² and 21,53 ft²).
  • Customers can change the size of an item from the cart.
  • Free updates and support for the licence period.

The free plugin stays free and has no time limit. Pro is a separate paid upgrade.

Safe by design

The price is always calculated on the server from the size the customer entered. The browser never sends a price, so it cannot be changed. Anything in the cart without a valid size is removed.

Good to know

  • Product grids show a “Choose size” button instead of “Add to cart”, because the size is needed first.
  • Sizes are set per product, in the General tab of the product editor.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate Meterwise.
  3. Edit a product, open the General tab, tick “Price by size” and fill in the settings.
  4. Set the normal product price to the price per m² (or per m).
sections.faq:
Which price do I enter on the product?

The price per unit you chose: per m², m, ft², ft, yd² or yd. The final price is that price multiplied by the area or length.

Can customers enter millimetres but I price per square metre?

Yes. Choose “Customer enters size in: Millimetres” and “Price is per: Square metre”.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Set the size options on the variable product, then give each variation its price per unit.

Can the customer change the price in the browser?

No. The price is calculated again on the server when the item is added and every time the cart is calculated.

Do I need Meterwise Pro?

No. The free plugin prices by width and height or length, with limits and a live price. Pro adds what shops usually need once they sell every day: price tables, waste, minimum price, fixed fee, shipping weight, selling in packs or rolls, stock in square metres, metric and imperial together, and changing a size from the cart.

Does the plugin send data to another site?

Only if you choose to. Meterwise uses the Freemius SDK for licences and updates of the optional Pro version. Nothing is sent until you click “Allow” on the opt-in screen. You can skip it and use the free plugin as normal. See https://freemius.com/privacy/ for what Freemius collects when you allow it.
sections.changelog:
0.8.6

  • Fixed: the description no longer lists translations that are not included.

0.8.5

  • Fixed: removed the Domain Path header, translations come from translate.wordpress.org.

0.8.4

  • Changed: the bundled Freemius SDK no longer includes development files.

0.8.3

  • Changed: all Pro calculation code (waste, packs, fixed fee, minimum price, wallpaper by the roll) now lives only in the Pro version. The free version contains no Pro code.
  • Changed: admin styles are loaded as a stylesheet, and translation files are left to translate.wordpress.org.

0.8.2

  • Improved: plugin tags changed so the plugin is easier to find.

0.8.1

  • Improved: the Pro options on the product screen are now one compact list with a single Pro badge.
  • Improved: Dutch translation of the new texts.

0.8.0

  • New: price per metre or foot of edge (perimeter) and per cubic metre or cubic foot (with a fixed thickness).
  • New: Meterwise Pro can sell wallpaper by the roll, with roll width, roll length, pattern repeat and extra length per strip.
  • New: Meterwise Pro can add a “Request a quote” button that emails you the sizes and the calculated price.
  • New: Meterwise Pro can import size pricing for many products from a CSV file (WooCommerce > Meterwise import).
  • Improved: complete Dutch translation of the new texts.

0.7.1

  • Improved: “Minimum billable size” is now labelled with its unit (m², m, ft²…) and explained as a size, not a price.
  • New: the free version lists the Pro options on the product screen, so you can see what Pro adds.
  • New: a Meterwise page under WooCommerce with a short how-it-works guide and an overview of the Pro features.

0.7.0

  • New: Meterwise Pro can sell in whole packs, boxes or rolls (size rounded up, packs shown in cart and order).
  • New: Meterwise Pro can count stock in the price unit (m², m, ft², ft) and refuses orders above the available amount.
  • New: the live price is shown in a clear block, with a hint until the customer has entered a size.
  • New: the free version shows which options Meterwise Pro adds, on the product screen and on a Meterwise page under WooCommerce.

0.6.1

  • Fixed: the opt-in and licence screen could not be opened. Meterwise now has its own page under WooCommerce.

0.6.0

  • Changed: waste, minimum price per item, fixed fee, weight per unit, metric and imperial display and changing a size from the cart are now part of Meterwise Pro.

0.5.1

  • Changed: internal function names use a longer prefix.

0.5.0

  • New: Meterwise Pro with price tables (matrix per width and height band, and tiers per amount).
  • New: optional licence and update handling through Freemius. Nothing is sent without your consent.

0.4.1

  • New: filters for add-ons to change the settings, the calculated price and the live preview.

0.4.0

  • New: yards and square yards.
  • New: sizes can be typed as fractions, for example 36 1/2.
  • New: new products start with the unit of your shop (inches and square feet for a US shop).
  • New: translations for Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Changed: the message for an invalid size no longer depends on lower-casing the field name, which broke German.

0.3.0

  • New: fixed fee per item.
  • New: show metric and imperial together.
  • New: change the size of an item from the cart.
  • New: [meterwise_fields] shortcode for page builders, and CSS variables for styling.

0.2.0

  • New: extra for waste (percentage).
  • New: weight per unit, used for shipping.
  • New: billed area shown next to the measured area in the cart, order and emails.
  • Tighter input checks for very large numbers.

0.1.0

  • First release.
